### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, activities A14, A17, A18, A19, and A20 each appeared in a minority of traces (about 17%, 25%, 27%, 14%, and 19% respectively) and never co-occurred with each other; each was followed by A28. [OCC001, OCC004-OCC007, DIR001, DIR004-DIR007, REL003-REL006, REL029-REL031]
- In the later window, these five activities are absent (0% participation). [OCC001, OCC004-OCC007, DIR001, DIR004-DIR007]
- In the later window, activities A15, A16, A25, A26, and A27 appear in every trace (100% participation) and co-occur with each other in every trace, with no fixed order (about half the time one precedes the other). [OCC002, OCC003, OCC008-OCC010, REL010, REL015-REL017, REL024-REL026, REL051-REL052, REL055]
- The start activity A43 (present in all traces in both windows) changed its outgoing edges: in the earlier window it led to the old alternatives (A14, A17-A20); in the later window it leads to the new activities (A15, A16, A25-A27). [DIR011]
- The end activity A28 (present in all traces in both windows) is now reached from the new activities instead of the old ones, and its position shifts later (mean relative position from about 0.39 to 0.47), while A43 shifts slightly earlier (0.32 to 0.29). [DIR002-DIR003, DIR008-DIR010, POS011, POS012]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a change in the control-flow structure: the process previously had a choice among alternative activities (A14, A17-A20) after A43 and before A28; in the later window these are replaced by a set of activities (A15, A16, A25-A27) that are all executed together in each case, in a flexible order, still between A43 and A28. This is directly shown by the disappearance of the old activities, the appearance of the new ones in every trace, the co-occurrence of the new ones, and the change in outgoing edges of A43 and incoming edges to A28. The shift of A28 to a later position is consistent with a longer middle segment. A competing explanation that the process was completely redesigned with different activities cannot be fully ruled out, but the shared start (A43) and end (A28) in both windows support a change in the middle part.

Other differences: The relative positions of A43 and A28 shifted (A43 earlier, A28 later), consistent with the change in the middle segment.
